scope: Source review and two no-host adversarial controls only. No production cache, container, image, volume, keys, artwork, database, process or network action.

findings.title: Missing cwd or executable path hides remaining live process references
findings.trigger: A process entry still has a cache-file FD while its cwd or exe target no longer resolves.
findings.observed: The broad FileNotFoundError/ProcessLookupError handler skips the entire PID before scanning fd/maps/mountinfo. The independent fake-proc fixture has an existing cache FD, but no_references accepts it. A deleted cwd is not proof that its process exited.
findings.requiredBehavior: Continue the remaining reference checks for a still-present process. Confirm a PID is gone before discarding its whole entry; unresolved live reference state must fail closed.

findings.title: Post-rename error loses quarantine tracking and restoration
findings.trigger: renameat2 has succeeded, then source/destination fsync or the registered signal handler raises before moved.append.
findings.observed: Using a real test-owned rename followed by an injected error, the first cache root disappears from its original path, remains in quarantine-0, and the durable failure receipt reports restoration:[] and removed:[]. The root is never reconciled or restored.
findings.requiredBehavior: Track an attempted move before the uncertain operation and reconcile source/quarantine by exact authenticated inode before restoration. Preserve foreign occupants, attempt both known/uncertain roots, and durably report retained quarantine if restoration cannot be confirmed.

independentControls.scope: Synthetic proc fixture plus real macOS test-owned directory rename with injected post-mutation error. No Linux renameat2 or real live-host qualification claimed.
